scenarios.assessment: Connection/account/workspace identities and destination IDs determine selection, never display names. ClickUp verifies list membership and uses discovered field IDs/types/statuses; shared lists require a verified discriminator. Notion uses data-source IDs and discovered properties/types, not hardcoded equivalent schemas. Both reject missing mappings/capabilities and prohibit schema creation.

Markdown reference specifies immutable UUID filenames, canonical-source and actual-action matching across complete relevant records, preserving metadata/evidence, reread before atomic update and read-back. Independently enacted create/repeated-capture update/read-only review in temporary root; one file and UUID persisted and unrelated text survived. None resolved distinctly and invokes no content access. Explicit standalone Markdown and Zotero modes remain separate from Second Brain.

local_enactment.limitation: Direct manual enactment by independent agent from instructions; not proof of autonomous future agent behavior or a Markdown writer CLI.
